title.zh: 傳言：「電視台今晚將現場直播廣場對話」
title.en: Rumor: 'Television will broadcast the Square dialogue live tonight'

summary.zh: 這是遊戲虛構的現場傳言，用來呈現資訊混亂與等待中的焦慮：現實中 5 月 14 日對話是否現場直播確曾引發激烈爭執且最終未能落實，玩家在廣場營地內只能聽見片斷耳語，當下無法核實真偽。
summary.en: A fictional camp rumor illustrating confusion and anxious waiting: in reality, disputes over live television coverage of the 14 May talks broke down, leaving people in the Square with conflicting fragments of news.
